errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.

fieldErrors.underAge: You must be 18 or older to register.
fieldErrors.dateInFuture: This date cannot be in the future.
fieldErrors.consentRequired: This consent is needed to register.

privacyNotice.title: Privacy notice
privacyNotice.draftBanner: DRAFT — this notice has not been approved by the hospital's legal team or data protection officer. Do not submit real personal data.
privacyNotice.intro: Queseir Hospital Blood Bank keeps a register of people who are willing to donate blood, so that staff can contact them when blood is needed.
privacyNotice.controllerBody: The data controller and the data protection officer's contact details will be published here once confirmed.
privacyNotice.dataBody: Your name, mobile number, date of birth, city and area, preferred contact method, the blood group you tell us (if you know it), and whether and roughly when you donated before. Blood-bank staff may later record verification, eligibility and donation information.
privacyNotice.purposeBody: To keep the donor register and, if you agree, to contact you by phone or WhatsApp when a matching donation is needed. We do not send automatic messages and do not share your data for other purposes.
privacyNotice.sensitiveBody: Your blood group and donation history are health information. We only process them with your explicit consent.
privacyNotice.retentionBody: Retention periods are being confirmed and will be published here.
privacyNotice.rightsBody: You can ask to see, correct or delete your data, and you can withdraw either consent at any time by contacting the blood bank. Withdrawing consent removes you from donor recall.
privacyNotice.consentRegistry: I agree that Queseir Hospital Blood Bank may store and process my data, including my blood group (health information), to keep the donor register.
privacyNotice.consentContact: I agree to be contacted by phone or WhatsApp about blood donation needs.

register.title: Register as a blood donor
register.intro: Fill in this short form. Blood-bank staff will review it and contact you. Registering does not mean you can donate yet; staff confirm that at your visit.
register.bloodGroupHint: If you are not sure, choose "Don't know".
register.lastDonationMonth: Approximate month of your last donation
register.consentIntro: Please read the privacy notice. Each consent is separate and optional to tick, but we can only register you if you agree to the first one.
register.throttled: Too many registrations from this connection. Please try again later.
register.unavailable: Registration is not available right now. Please try again later.
register.thanksBody: We have received your registration. Blood-bank staff will contact you. If you need to change your details, please contact the blood bank.

donors.title: Donors
donors.pendingIntro: New registrations and donors flagged for review. Confirm identity and contact, then verify or reject.
donors.emptyRegistry: No donors yet. Registrations from the public form appear in Pending review.
donors.count: {count, plural, =0 {No donors} one {# donor} other {# donors}}
donors.searchLabel: Search by name or mobile number
donors.searchHint: Search is not saved in the address bar, to keep personal data out of links and logs.
donors.newIntro: For walk-ins and paper forms. Confirm that the donor gave each consent before ticking it.
donors.verifyNow: Verify now (identity and contact confirmed in person)
donors.phoneChangeWarning: Changing the mobile number returns the donor to Pending verification.
donors.staffConsentRegistry: The donor consented to the registry (data storage and processing).
donors.staffConsentContact: The donor consented to be contacted about donation needs.
donors.duplicatePhone: A donor with this mobile number is already registered.

profile.revealAudited: Viewing the full number is recorded in the audit log.
profile.bloodGroupVerificationBlocked: Blood-group verification is not available yet: the blood bank has not approved the verification methods (Medical Rule Required M6).

verification.title: Verification
verification.verifyHelp: Identity and contact confirmed (usually by phone).
verification.rejectConfirm: Reject this registration? The donor will not appear in the donor pool unless an administrator reopens it.
verification.clearReviewHelp: The donor submitted the public form again. Check their details, then mark as reviewed.

eligibility.title: Eligibility
eligibility.noteHint: Required for deferrals. Deferral categories will be added once approved (Medical Rule Required M7).
eligibility.correctHelp: Administrator correction of a permanent deferral. A reason is required.
eligibility.noTransitions: No assessment can be recorded from the current status.

activity.title: Activity
activity.deactivateConfirm: Mark this donor inactive? They will be excluded from matching.
activity.reactivateBlocked: Reactivation needs active registry and contact consent.

consent.title: Consent
consent.withdrawConfirm: Record that the donor withdrew this consent? The donor becomes inactive and is excluded from matching immediately.
consent.grantHelp: Only when the donor has given this consent again, in person or by phone.
